TC-17/S19.title: Forced note failure on charts with no note, both contexts: Post-Round explains, no Copy, no endless 'Finalizing…', dictation survives a reload
TC-17/S19.detail: One physician, a Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident with a saved pre-round and no note (rawPreRoundNotes seeded equal to preRoundNotes; the matrix seed leaves it out, and then Generate refuses with 'edited after it was last processed'); spec newspec-c/flt-tc17-s19-note-fail.spec.ts. Every ai/notes:generateNote attempt fails at the socket. Judged 20/21. Fail (known B27): Hospital Post-Round still shows the disabled 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' spinner 10 s after the failure (the chart stays 'seen', never note-ready). Pass: Post-Round in both contexts says 'No note generated yet.' with no note, no SUBJECTIVE / SNF FOLLOW-UP, no Copy to EMR or Copy Assessment & Plan; Nursing Home Post-Round has no spinner and nothing of the Hospital chart; the Nursing Home Encounter tab shows 'The visit dictation is saved, but the note couldn’t be generated. Check your connection and tap Generate Note & Finish to retry.'; no note stored; after a reload the typed dictation is on Encounter and in encounterNotes in both contexts. Recorded, D7 / Q5 (wording and place): Post-Round never says 'not generated' and names no retry — it says 'Complete the Encounter tab first.'; Encounter says 'couldn’t be generated'. Recorded, Q13: Hospital offers no 'Mark Encounter Complete' (the spinner button instead); Nursing Home shows 'Mark Visit Complete' disabled. RG-DIAG: one client generateNote call per chart (the server's retries are not exercised by a socket failure).
TC-17/S19.productIssue: After a failed note generation on a Hospital chart, Post-Round shows a 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' spinner that never ends under 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.'
